conbody.p: MAX_FS_WRITERS query option The MAX_FS_WRITERS query option sets an upper limit on the number of writer instances to be scheduled during an INSERT operation.
When set to a positive integer, this option constrains the number of parallel write instances during INSERT operations on HDFS and Kudu targets.

When this option is enabled, the planner may add an exchange node in the root fragment to control the write parallelism. The scheduler distributes the limited writer instances evenly across available backends using round-robin assignment.
Set this option to 0 (the default) to disable any writer limit. When set to a positive value, this option takes precedence over the "no-shuffle" hint.

A mismatch of cluster state during query planning and scheduling can result in more or less fragment instances to be scheduled than expected. For example, if max_fs_writers is 2 and the planner sees only 2 executors then it might not add an exchange between a scan node and the table sink, but during scheduling if there are 3 nodes then that scan+tablesink instance will be scheduled on 3 backends. When this occurs, Impala logs a warning: Extra table sink instances scheduled, probably due to mismatch of cluster state during planning vs scheduling. Expected: 2 Found: 3
